nome: inemaSEO 4 — In the AIs: AEO, GEO, and sites used by agents

lado_card.texto: With AI measurement in place, course 5 puts agents in the terminal to do the repetitive work, always with a human gate.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning format v7.2 · eventos.inema.pro/inemaseo · inemaSEO method (MIT) · inemaseo-sistemas (MIT) · inema.club

inicio.titulo: In the AIs: AEO, GEO, and sites used by agents
inicio.lead: Getting cited by AIs doesn't call for a magic file. It calls for well-done SEO, content only you have, and honest measurement. In eight lessons you separate fundamentals from fads, read the official dashboards, measure citations by hand every month, fix your entity, check the bots in the log, and get your site ready for agents.
inicio.capa_alt: A small bakery owner reads an answer on her phone, behind the counter.
inicio.aulas_sub: In work order: separate the myth, measure in the dashboards and by hand, fix who you are for the AIs, check who reads your site, and get your site ready to be used by agents.

itens: Owners of sites or small businesses who want to show up when someone asks an AI about their topic.
Marketing or SEO professionals who get requests for "GEO" and want to separate what has a source from what's a fad.
Anyone who has already done the foundation (course 1) and wants to measure the effect in the AIs without paying for a tool.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Say, with sources, what Google, Bing, and the AI companies ask for and what nobody asks for.
Read the Search Console AI report and Bing's AI Performance and build your baseline.
Run a battery of frozen questions on 4 assistants by hand every month, with a spreadsheet.
Fix name collisions, see in the log which bots read your site, and register the first WebMCP tool on a test page.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in the inemaSEO Program
itens: 1 Foundation, 2 Content, and 3 Measurement: the groundwork, the pages only you write, and the non-branded number.
4 In the AIs (this course): the official AI dashboards, citation measurement, and the site ready for agents.
5 With Agents and 6 Professional: agents doing the repetitive work, and SEO + AI as a service.
7 Systems: the 5 open tools of inemaseo-sistemas, your own open Semrush.
All of them follow the open inemaSEO method (MIT), applied to INEMA's own sites.
